darren: Hey team — PR #9173 is blocked by CI gate. Two consecutive buildkite runs failed the smoke/infer-e2e job. I don't think my small doc change should affect this but it's preventing the merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9173
build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/redwood/builds/45213

Log snippet:
```
[smoke_infer_gpu] ERROR: OOM while allocating 8.2GB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
```
Can someone take a quick look? Thanks.

jamie: @darren I'm free, will check the log and rerun the job now.

ci-bot: buildkite: Rebuild triggered by jamie — build 45214

jamie: Rerun finished: still failing, same OOM. Looks infra-ish; test is using full-batch config. @maria any recent infra changes on the GPU pools?

maria: No config changes I pushed. We've had two node reboots in us-west-2 last night due to kernel updates; might be resource fragmentation. Can you try reducing the batch size in the test or switch to smaller smoke env?

jamie: I'll try a quick bisect: rerunning with --smoke-small to see if it passes. If it does, we can merge and follow up with infra ticket.

darren: Thanks — if bisect passes, feel free to merge. Otherwise please open an incidents ticket and I'll hold off.

jamie: Update: small-smoke run passed (build 45215). Creating a minimal change to test runner to use smaller batch in smoke for now. Filing infra ticket: #INC-342.

darren: Awesome, thx :thumbsup:
